scripts.desktop:lint:js: eslint src vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts tools/version-contract.mjs tools/desktop-boundary-contracts.test.mjs
scripts.desktop:lint:rust: npm run desktop:host:stage && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.desktop:check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && npm run desktop:test:unit
scripts.desktop:test: npm run desktop:test:unit && npm run desktop:test:rust && npm run desktop:contracts
scripts.desktop:test:rust: npm run desktop:host:stage && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:test:rust:sync: npm run desktop:host:stage && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --features sync-preview
scripts.desktop:ci: npm run desktop:version:check && npm run desktop:lint:js && npm run desktop:contracts && npm run desktop:check && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:lint:rust && npm run desktop:test:rust && npm run desktop:test:rust:sync
scripts.desktop:bundle:prepare: npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:host:stage
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:js && npm run desktop:lint:rust
scripts.release:check: npm run desktop:ci && npm run desktop:host:stage
scripts.release:bundle:linux:unsigned: npm run desktop:linux:bundle-prerequisites && tauri build --bundles deb,rpm,appimage --config '{"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false}}'
scripts.desktop:linux:dev: npm run desktop:linux:prerequisites && npm run tauri:dev:browser
